notes: Each of 230 precincts has a "Republican County Committee Member" contest (Vote for 2), so seats are labelled "County Committee Member". Republican committee contests also appeared in the 2024 primary; 2026 is used as the most recent. Filled = a ballot candidate placed in the top two with more votes than all write-ins combined. Empty = an open seat beyond the number of write-in votes cast (each write-in vote can elect at most one person). Unknown = an open seat that write-in votes could have filled (193 seats). The official report names some write-in recipients ("Write-In: ..."), but write-in winners are kept unknown because no county list confirms who qualified or accepted.
